耶稣.usage: The name of Jesus — the main person of this story. Chinese Bible names copy the sound of the original name.

会堂.usage: 会 (gather) + 堂 (hall) = the hall where Jewish people gathered to worship. 进了会堂 = went into the synagogue.

安息日.usage: 安息 (rest) + 日 (day) = the rest day, when no work was allowed. 在安息日 = on the Sabbath.

法利赛人.usage: A group of very strict religious leaders. The ending 人 means "people (of that group)".

希律.usage: King Herod. 希律一党的人 = the people of Herod's party (the Herodians).

加利利.usage: The region where Jesus lived and taught. 从加利利 = from Galilee.

犹太.usage: The region around Jerusalem. Here it is one of the places people came from.

耶路撒冷.usage: The most important city, where the temple was.

以土买.usage: A region south of Judea — people came even from this far place.

约旦河.usage: 河 = river. 约旦河外 = the land beyond the Jordan River.

泰尔.usage: A seaside city to the north. People came from around Tyre and Sidon too.

西顿.usage: Another seaside city near Tyre, far to the north.

污鬼.usage: 污 (dirty, unclean) + 鬼 (spirit, demon). The unclean spirits fell down before Jesus.

神.usage: 神的儿子 = the Son of God — what the spirits shouted about Jesus.

西门.usage: Two apostles share this name: Simon (renamed Peter) and 奋锐党的西门 (Simon the Zealot).

彼得.usage: The new name Jesus gave Simon. 起名叫彼得 = named him Peter (the name means "rock").

西庇太.usage: The father of James and John. 西庇太的儿子雅各 = James the son of Zebedee.

雅各.usage: Two apostles share this name: James son of Zebedee, and James son of Alphaeus (亚勒腓的儿子雅各).

约翰.usage: 雅各的兄弟约翰 = John, the brother of James.

半尼其.usage: A nickname Jesus gave James and John. The next words explain it: 就是雷子的意思 = which means "sons of thunder".

雷子.usage: 雷 (thunder) + 子 (sons). The meaning of the nickname 半尼其.

安得烈.usage: One of the twelve apostles, Simon Peter's brother.

马太.usage: One of the twelve apostles — a tax collector before following Jesus.

亚勒腓.usage: The father of the second James: 亚勒腓的儿子雅各.

奋锐党.usage: 奋锐 (zealous, fiery) + 党 (party). 奋锐党的西门 = Simon from the Zealot party.

加略人.usage: 加略 is a place name + 人 (person from there). 加略人犹大 = Judas Iscariot.

犹大.usage: 卖耶稣的加略人犹大 = Judas Iscariot, who betrayed (sold) Jesus.

进.usage: 进了会堂 = went into the synagogue. 进 + 了 shows the action is completed.

枯干.usage: 枯 (withered) + 干 (dry). 枯干了一只手 = one of his hands had withered.

手.usage: The story is about a man's withered hand: 一只手 = one hand.

人.usage: 有一个人 = there was a person. Also in group names like 法利赛人 (Pharisee-people).

众人.usage: 众 (many) + 人 (people). 众人窥探耶稣 = the people all watched Jesus closely.

窥探.usage: They watched Jesus secretly, hoping to catch him doing something wrong.

医治.usage: 医治不医治 = "will he heal or not heal?" Repeating a verb with 不 in the middle makes a yes/no question.

意思.usage: v.2 意思是要控告耶稣 = their intention was to accuse Jesus. v.13 随自己的意思 = according to his own wish. v.17 雷子的意思 = the meaning "sons of thunder".

控告.usage: 要控告耶稣 = they wanted to accuse Jesus of breaking the Sabbath law.

说.usage: 对那人说 = said to that man. 说 usually comes right before the words someone speaks.

起来.usage: Jesus' command to the man: 起来 = Get up!

站.usage: 站在当中 = stand in the middle (where everyone can see).

当中.usage: 站在当中 = stand in the middle of everyone.

问.usage: 又问众人说 = then he asked the crowd.

行善.usage: 行 (to do) + 善 (good). Jesus asks: on the Sabbath, 行善 or 行恶 — which is allowed?

行恶.usage: 行 (to do) + 恶 (evil). The opposite of 行善.

救命.usage: 救 (save) + 命 (life). Paired with its opposite 害命 in Jesus' question.

害命.usage: 害 (harm) + 命 (life). The opposite of 救命.

作声.usage: 他们都不作声 = they all kept silent — nobody dared to answer.

怒目.usage: 怒 (anger) + 目 (eyes). 怒目周围看他们 = looked around at them with anger.

看.usage: 怒目周围看他们 = looked around at them (with angry eyes).

忧愁.usage: Jesus was both angry and sad: 忧愁他们的心刚硬 = grieved that their hearts were hard.

心.usage: 他们的心刚硬 = their hearts were hard (stubborn, without pity).

刚硬.usage: 心刚硬 = hard-hearted — they cared more about rules than about the sick man.

伸出.usage: 伸 (stretch) + 出 (out). Jesus' command: 伸出手来 = Stretch out your hand!

伸.usage: 把手一伸 = with one stretch of his hand. 一 + verb means "in one motion, as soon as".

复了原.usage: This is 复原 (recover) with 了 in the middle. 手就复了原 = the hand was made completely well again.

出去.usage: 法利赛人出去 = the Pharisees went out (of the synagogue).

一党.usage: 希律一党的人 = the people of Herod's party — usually enemies of the Pharisees, but here they team up.

商议.usage: 商议怎样可以除灭耶稣 = plotted how they could destroy Jesus.

怎样.usage: 怎样可以除灭 = how they could destroy (him).

除灭.usage: 除 (remove) + 灭 (wipe out). A very strong word — they wanted to kill Jesus.

门徒.usage: Students who follow a teacher everywhere. 耶稣和门徒 = Jesus and his disciples.

退到.usage: 退 (step back) + 到 (arrive at). 退到海边去 = withdrew to the seaside.

海边.usage: 海 (sea) + 边 (side/edge) — the shore of the Sea of Galilee.

许多.usage: 许多人 = many people. 治好了许多人 = healed many people.

跟随.usage: 跟随他 = followed him (wherever he went).

听见.usage: 听 (listen) + 见 (perceive): the sound reached their ears. 听见他所做的大事 = heard about the great things he did.

做.usage: 他所做的大事 = the great things that he did.

大事.usage: 大 (great) + 事 (things) — the miracles Jesus did.

外.usage: 约旦河外 = (the land) beyond the Jordan River.

四方.usage: 四 (four) + 方 (directions). 泰尔、西顿的四方 = the whole region around Tyre and Sidon.

来到.usage: 来到他那里 = came to (the place where) he (was).

吩咐.meaning: to instruct, tell (someone to do something)
吩咐.usage: 吩咐门徒 = told the disciples (to get a boat ready).

小船.usage: 小 (small) + 船 (boat). 叫一只小船伺候着 = have a small boat kept ready.

伺候.usage: 伺候着 = staying ready to serve — the boat waited nearby in case the crowd pressed too hard.

免得.usage: 免得众人拥挤他 = so that the crowd would not crush him.

拥挤.usage: So many people pushed toward Jesus that they might crush him.

治好.usage: 治 (treat) + 好 (well). 治好了许多人 = had healed many people.

灾病.usage: 灾 (disaster) + 病 (sickness). 凡有灾病的 = all who had diseases.

挤进来.usage: 挤 (squeeze) + 进来 (come in). The sick pushed through the crowd to reach Jesus.

摸.usage: 要摸他 = wanted to touch him — they believed touching Jesus would heal them.

看见.usage: 看 (look) + 见 (perceive). 无论何时看见他 = whenever they saw him.

俯伏.meaning: to fall down, bow to the ground
俯伏.usage: 俯伏在他面前 = fell down before him.

面前.usage: 在他面前 = before him, in front of him.

喊.usage: 喊着说 = cried out, saying. The 着 shows the shouting keeps going while they speak.

儿子.usage: 神的儿子 = the Son of God. Also 西庇太的儿子 = the son of Zebedee.

再三.usage: 再 (again) + 三 (three) — literally "again and a third time". 再三的嘱咐 = warned them repeatedly.

嘱咐.usage: To tell someone firmly and seriously. 耶稣再三的嘱咐他们 = Jesus strictly ordered them.

显露.usage: 不要把他显露出来 = do not make him known (do not tell everyone who he is).

出来.usage: After a verb, 出来 means the action brings something into the open: 显露出来 = reveal openly.

上.usage: 上了山 = went up the mountain.

山.usage: 耶稣上了山 = Jesus went up the mountain.

随.usage: 随自己的意思 = according to his own wish — Jesus himself chose whom to call.

自己.usage: 自己的意思 = his own wish. 和自己同在 = to be with him (Jesus himself).

设立.usage: 设立十二个人 = appointed twelve people (the twelve apostles).

十二.usage: 十 (ten) + 二 (two) = 12. 十二个人 = twelve people.

同在.usage: 常和自己同在 = to be with him always — the first job of the twelve.

差.usage: 差他们去传道 = send them out to preach. (In this meaning 差 is read chāi, not chà.)

传道.usage: 传 (spread) + 道 (the Way, the message) = spread God's message.

权柄.usage: 权 (power) + 柄 (handle). 给他们权柄赶鬼 = gave them authority to cast out demons.

起名.usage: 起名叫彼得 = gave him the name Peter. 给…起名叫… = named (someone) (a name).

兄弟.usage: 雅各的兄弟约翰 = John, the brother of James.

卖.usage: 卖耶稣的 = the one who betrayed (literally "sold") Jesus — for thirty pieces of silver.

又.usage: 耶稣又进了会堂 = Jesus went into the synagogue again. Also joins actions: 又问众人 = and he asked the crowd.

了.usage: Placed after a verb to show the action is finished: 进了 = entered, 上了山 = went up the mountain, 治好了 = has healed.

在.usage: 在那里 = there (at that place); 在安息日 = on the Sabbath; 站在当中 = stand in the middle.

那里.usage: 在那里 = in that place. 来到他那里 = came to where he was.

有.usage: 有一个人 = there was a person. 凡有灾病的 = all who had diseases. 这十二个人有西门 = among the twelve was Simon.

一个.usage: Number 一 + measure word 个. 一个人 = one person.

一只.usage: 只 is the measure word for hands, boats and animals: 一只手 = one hand; 一只小船 = a small boat.

不.usage: 医治不医治 = heal or not heal? 不作声 = made no sound.

是.usage: 你是神的儿子 = You are the Son of God. 意思是… = the meaning is…

要.meaning: to want to; to be about to
要.usage: 要控告耶稣 = wanted to accuse Jesus. 要他们常和自己同在 = wanted them to be with him.

对.usage: Marks who is spoken to: 对那人说 = said to that man.

那.usage: 那人 = that man; 那枯干一只手的人 = that man with the withered hand.

的.usage: Connects a description to a noun: 神的儿子 = God's son; 枯干一只手的人 = the man whose hand was withered.

地.meaning: (particle: turns a word into HOW something is done)
地.usage: Comes before a verb: 再三地嘱咐 = warned them again and again, earnestly.

哪样.usage: 哪 = which. 哪样是可以的呢？ = which one is allowed (to do good, or to do evil)?

可以.usage: 是可以的 = is allowed. 怎样可以除灭耶稣 = how they could destroy Jesus.

呢.usage: Placed at the end to soften a question: 哪样是可以的呢？ = so which one is allowed?

他们.usage: 他 (he) + 们 (plural marker). 他们都不作声 = they all said nothing.

都.usage: 他们都不作声 = they ALL kept silent; 都挤进来 = all pushed in.

就.usage: Links to what happens next: 手就复了原 = and the hand was restored at once.

来.usage: 叫人来 = called people to come. After a verb it points toward the speaker: 伸出手来 = stretch out (your) hand (toward me).

他.usage: 他把手一伸 = he stretched out his hand; 跟随他 = followed him.

把.meaning: (particle: moves the object before the verb)
把.usage: 把手一伸 = took his hand and stretched it. 把他显露出来 = make him known.

一.meaning: one; (with a verb) in one motion
一.usage: 手一伸 = with one stretch of the hand — 一 + verb means "as soon as, in one quick motion".

同.usage: 同希律一党的人商议 = plotted together with Herod's party.

和.usage: 耶稣和门徒 = Jesus and the disciples; 常和自己同在 = be together with him.

去.usage: After a place it shows moving away: 退到海边去 = went off to the seaside. 差他们去传道 = send them out to preach.

从.usage: 从加利利 = from Galilee; 从犹太 = from Judea.

还有.usage: 还有许多人 = and many more people also (came). 还有卖耶稣的犹大 = and also Judas who betrayed Jesus.

所.usage: 他所做的大事 = the great things THAT he did. 所 + verb turns the action into "the things done".

并.usage: Joins list items: 并泰尔、西顿 = and Tyre and Sidon; 并给他们权柄 = and gave them authority.

因为.usage: 因为人多 = because there were so many people.

多.usage: 人多 = the people were many (it was very crowded).

叫.meaning: to tell/ask (someone to do); to call, name
叫.usage: v.9 叫一只小船伺候着 = have a boat kept ready; v.13 叫人来 = called people to come; v.16 起名叫彼得 = named him Peter.

着.usage: Shows an action keeps going: 伺候着 = staying ready; 喊着说 = kept shouting while saying.

所以.usage: 所以凡有灾病的都挤进来 = therefore all the sick pushed in.

凡.usage: 凡有灾病的 = all those who had diseases.

无论.usage: 无论何时 = no matter when = whenever.

何时.usage: A formal word for 什么时候. 无论何时看见他 = whenever they saw him.

你.usage: 你是神的儿子 = YOU are the Son of God.

不要.usage: 不要把他显露出来 = do not make him known.

便.usage: 他们便来到他那里 = and so they came to him.

个.usage: 十二个人 = twelve people; 两个人 = two people.

常.usage: 常和自己同在 = to be with him always.

也.usage: 也要差他们去传道 = and also to send them out to preach.

给.usage: 给他们权柄 = gave them authority; 给他起名 = gave him a name.

这.usage: 这十二个人 = these twelve people; 这两个人 = these two people.

两个.usage: Before a measure word, "two" is 两 not 二: 这两个人 = these two people (James and John).

就是.usage: 就是雷子的意思 = which means "sons of thunder" — explaining the name 半尼其.

屋子.usage: 耶稣进了一个屋子 = Jesus went into a house.

聚集.usage: 众人又聚集 = the crowd gathered together again.

甚至.usage: It makes the next detail stronger: the crowd was so large that Jesus could not even eat.

连.usage: 连饭也顾不得吃 = he could not even take time to eat.

饭.usage: 吃饭 = eat a meal. Here 饭 is the food Jesus did not have time to eat.

顾不得.meaning: to have no time for; cannot attend to
顾不得.usage: 顾 (look after) + 不得 (cannot). 顾不得吃 = could not spare time to eat.

亲属.usage: 亲 (close) + 属 (belonging). 耶稣的亲属 = Jesus’ relatives.

拉住.usage: 拉 (pull) + 住 (hold firmly). They came to bring Jesus away.

癫狂.usage: This is what the relatives said about Jesus; it is their mistaken opinion, not what the lesson teaches.

下来.usage: 从耶路撒冷下来 = came down from Jerusalem.

文士.usage: 文 (writing) + 士 (learned person). 文士 studied and taught religious laws.

被.usage: 被别西卜附着 = said to be possessed by Beelzebul. 被 marks something happening to someone.

别西卜.usage: A name the scribes used for the ruler of demons.

附着.usage: 附 (attach) + 着 (remain attached). The scribes wrongly claimed an unclean spirit was attached to Jesus.

靠着.usage: 靠着鬼王赶鬼 = by the power of the ruler of demons, as the scribes falsely claimed.

鬼王.usage: 鬼 (demon) + 王 (king). This is the accusation the scribes made.

用.usage: 用比喻 = by using a parable.

比喻.usage: Jesus uses an everyday picture, such as a house, to teach an important idea.

撒但.usage: The Chinese Bible name for Satan. Jesus asks whether Satan could drive out Satan.

怎能.usage: 怎 (how) + 能 (can). 撒但怎能赶出撒但呢？ = How can Satan drive out Satan?

赶出.usage: 赶 (drive away) + 出 (out). 赶出撒但 = drive Satan out.

若.usage: A formal Bible word for 如果. 若一国… = if a kingdom…

一国.usage: 一 (one) + 国 (country). Jesus begins with the picture of a country divided against itself.

自相.usage: 自相纷争 = fight one another.

纷争.usage: 纷 (many tangled things) + 争 (fight). 自相纷争 = fighting each other.

那国.usage: 那 (that) + 国 (country). 那国就站立不住 = that country cannot stand.

站立不住.usage: Here it is a picture: a divided kingdom or family cannot keep going.

一家.usage: 一家自相纷争 = one family fighting among itself.

那家.usage: 那家就站立不住 = that family cannot stay together.

攻打.usage: 撒但自相攻打 = Satan attacking himself.

必要.usage: 必 (certainly) + 要 (will). 必要灭亡 = will surely fall apart.

灭亡.meaning: to perish; come to an end
灭亡.usage: 灭 (destroy) + 亡 (be gone). Here it means completely coming to an end.

没有人.usage: 没有人能… = no one can…

能.usage: 没有人能进… = no one is able to enter…

壮士.usage: 壮 (strong) + 士 (man). Jesus uses a strong man as part of a comparison story.

家.usage: 壮士的家 = the strong man’s home. 家 can mean a building or the people who live together.

家里.usage: 家 (home) + 里 (inside). 进壮士家里 = enter the strong man’s house.

抢夺.usage: 抢 (snatch) + 夺 (take away). It is part of Jesus’ comparison, not an instruction.

家具.usage: 家 (home) + 具 (things). 家具 means the things in a person’s house.

必先.usage: 必 (must) + 先 (first). 必先捆住… = must first tie up…

捆住.usage: 捆 (tie) + 住 (fasten firmly). It is part of the strong-man comparison.

才.usage: 必先…才可以… = only after doing the first thing can the next thing happen.

我.usage: 我实在告诉你们 = I truly tell you.

实在.usage: Jesus uses 实在 to show that his next words are very important.

告诉.usage: 告诉你们 = tell you all.

你们.usage: 你 (you) + 们 (plural). Jesus is speaking to more than one listener.

世人.usage: 世 (world) + 人 (people). 世人 means all people.

一切.usage: 一切的罪 = every kind of sin.

罪.usage: 罪 means actions and attitudes that go against God’s good way.

亵渎.meaning: to speak disrespectfully about what is holy
亵渎.usage: A serious word for treating God or holy things with contempt.

可得.usage: 可 (can) + 得 (receive). 可得赦免 = can receive forgiveness.

赦免.usage: 赦 (pardon) + 免 (release). 赦免 means being forgiven.

圣灵.usage: 圣 (holy) + 灵 (spirit). The Holy Spirit is God’s Holy Spirit.

却.usage: 却 shows a strong contrast with what was said before.

永不得.usage: 永 (forever) + 不得 (not receive). This is a very serious warning in the passage.

乃.usage: A formal Bible word that introduces what is true instead.

担当.usage: 担 (carry) + 当 (take on). 担当永远的罪 = bear the responsibility for an eternal sin.

永远.usage: 永 (forever) + 远 (far). 永远的罪 = an eternal sin.

这话.usage: 这话是因为… = Jesus said this because…

当下.usage: A Bible-style phrase for immediately at that time.

弟兄.usage: 弟 (younger brother) + 兄 (older brother). Here it means Jesus’ brothers.

外边.usage: 外 (outside) + 边 (side). 站在外边 = stand outside.

打发.usage: 打发人去叫他 = sent someone to call him.

坐着.usage: 坐 (sit) + 着 (ongoing state). 周围坐着的人 = the people sitting around him.

看哪.usage: A Bible phrase that calls attention to something important.

找.usage: 在外边找你 = outside looking for you.

回答.usage: 回 (reply) + 答 (answer). 耶稣回答说 = Jesus answered.

谁.usage: 谁是我的母亲？ = Who is my mother?

我的.usage: 我 (I) + 的 (possessive marker). 我的母亲 = my mother.

四面.usage: 四 (four) + 面 (sides). 四面观看 = looked all around.

观看.usage: 观 and 看 both mean look. 观看 is a more careful, formal kind of looking.

遵行.usage: 遵 (follow) + 行 (carry out). 遵行神旨意 = obey and do God’s will.

神旨意.usage: 神 (God) + 旨意 (purpose, will). It means what God wants people to do.

弟兄姊妹.usage: 弟兄 (brothers) + 姊妹 (sisters). Jesus calls everyone who obeys God’s will part of his family.

教训.usage: 本章中，教训 表示 to teach; teaching。

到.usage: 本章中，到 表示 to arrive at; to。

只得.usage: 本章中，只得 表示 have no choice but to。

上船.usage: 本章中，上船 表示 to board a boat。

坐下.usage: 本章中，坐下 表示 to sit down。

船.usage: 本章中，船 表示 boat。

海里.usage: 本章中，海里 表示 in the sea。

靠近.usage: 本章中，靠近 表示 to come close to。

海.usage: 本章中，海 表示 sea。

站在.usage: 本章中，站在 表示 to stand at。

岸上.usage: 本章中，岸上 表示 on the shore。

道理.usage: 本章中，道理 表示 teaching; truth。

之间.usage: 本章中，之间 表示 between; among。

听.usage: 本章中，听 表示 to listen; hear。

啊.usage: 本章中，啊 表示 an exclamation。

撒种.usage: 本章中，撒种 表示 to sow seed。

撒.usage: 本章中，撒 表示 to scatter; sow。

时候.usage: 本章中，时候 表示 time; when。

落在.usage: 本章中，落在 表示 to fall on。

路旁.usage: 本章中，路旁 表示 beside the path。

飞鸟.usage: 本章中，飞鸟 表示 birds。

吃尽.usage: 本章中，吃尽 表示 to eat it all。

土浅.usage: 本章中，土浅 表示 shallow soil。

石头地.usage: 本章中，石头地 表示 rocky ground。

土.usage: 本章中，土 表示 soil; earth。

既.usage: 本章中，既 表示 since; already。

深.usage: 本章中，深 表示 deep。

发苗.usage: 本章中，发苗 表示 to sprout。

最快.usage: 本章中，最快 表示 fastest。

日头.usage: 本章中，日头 表示 sun。

一晒.meaning: when the sun shines on it
一晒.usage: 本章中，一晒 表示 when the sun shines on it。

没有.usage: 本章中，没有 表示 not have; there is no。

explain.1: Jesus teaches by the lake again. The crowd is so big that he sits in a boat on the water while the people stand on the shore.
explain.2: He teaches with 比喻 — parables: everyday stories that carry a much bigger meaning.
explain.3: The story starts. A farmer goes out to scatter seed; 撒种 means to sow.
explain.4: Some seed lands on the hard path, and birds come and eat it all.
explain.5: Some lands on thin soil over rock, where it sprouts faster than anywhere else.
explain.6: But with no root, one hot day of sun dries it up.
explain.7: Some falls among thorns, which grow up and crowd it out, so it makes no grain. 结实 = to bear fruit.
explain.8: Some falls on good soil and grows into a harvest — thirty, sixty, even a hundred times what was sown.
explain.9: 「有耳可听的，就应当听！」 The story is a test of listening, not a lesson in farming.
explain.10: Later, when the crowd has gone, his followers and the twelve ask him what the parable means.
explain.11: Jesus says the secret of God's kingdom is given to them; for outsiders it stays wrapped up in stories.
explain.12: A hard heart can look without seeing and hear without understanding. The parable still leaves a door open for anyone who truly wants to turn back.
explain.13: He asks his own disciples first: if you miss this parable, how will you understand any of the others?
explain.14: Here is the key to the whole story: the seed is 道 — the word, God's message.
explain.15: Path soil is a person who hears the word, and Satan takes it away at once.
explain.16: Rocky soil is a person who is delighted the moment they hear it.
explain.17: But there is no root, so when trouble or persecution comes because of the word, they fall away just as quickly.
explain.18: Thorny soil is another person who hears the word.
explain.19: Then worries, the pull of money, and other wants crowd in and choke it, so nothing grows. 挤住 = squeezed out.
explain.20: Good soil is a person who hears, takes it in, and bears a harvest: thirty, sixty, a hundred times over.
explain.21: Nobody lights a lamp to hide it under a basket or a bed. You put it up where it lights the whole room.
explain.22: Hidden things are meant to come out. Jesus's teaching is not a secret to keep; it is a lamp.
explain.23: Again the same line: whoever has ears, listen.
explain.24: Pay attention to what you hear. The measuring cup you use for other people is the one used for you — and more will be added.
explain.25: Whoever has, gets more; whoever has nothing loses even that. What you do with what you hear decides which one you are.
explain.26: Another picture of God's kingdom: a man scatters seed on the ground.
explain.27: He sleeps at night and gets up by day, and the seed sprouts and grows without him knowing how.
explain.28: The ground grows the grain by itself: first the shoot, then the ear, then full kernels on the ear.
explain.29: When the grain is ripe he takes the sickle, because harvest time has come.
explain.30: Jesus asks what we could compare God's kingdom to, what picture would show it.
explain.31: A mustard seed — one of the tiniest seeds anyone plants in a field.
explain.32: Yet it grows taller than every garden plant, with branches big enough for birds to nest in its shade. Tiny start, huge ending.
explain.33: He taught with many stories like these, matching what his listeners were able to take in.
explain.34: In public he always used parables; alone with the disciples he explained everything.
explain.35: That evening Jesus says to the disciples: let us cross over to the other side.
explain.36: They leave the crowd behind and take him across, still in the boat. Other boats go along too.
explain.37: A sudden squall hits. Waves break into the boat until it is nearly full of water.
explain.38: Jesus is asleep on a cushion in the stern. They wake him: 夫子! We are dying — don't you care?
explain.39: He wakes, scolds the wind, and says to the sea 「住了吧！静了吧！」 The wind drops and the water goes completely calm.
explain.40: His question back to them: why so frightened? Do you still have no faith?
explain.41: Now they are afraid of something else altogether: who is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?
